from itertools import accumulate
from math import gcd


def best_average(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    prefix = list(accumulate(a, initial=0))

    hull: list[int] = []
    head = 0
    best_num = -1
    best_den = 1

    for j in range(k, n + 1):
        p = j - k
        sp = prefix[p]

        while len(hull) - head >= 2:
            u = hull[-2]
            v = hull[-1]
            if (prefix[v] - prefix[u]) * (p - v) >= (sp - prefix[v]) * (v - u):
                hull.pop()
            else:
                break
        hull.append(p)

        sj = prefix[j]
        while len(hull) - head >= 2:
            h0 = hull[head]
            h1 = hull[head + 1]
            if (sj - prefix[h0]) * (j - h1) <= (sj - prefix[h1]) * (j - h0):
                head += 1
            else:
                break

        h0 = hull[head]
        num = sj - prefix[h0]
        den = j - h0
        if num * best_den > best_num * den:
            best_num = num
            best_den = den

    g = gcd(best_num, best_den)
    return [best_num // g, best_den // g]
